newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends mixed, nearbys at day's low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends mixed, nearbys at day's low.

text.p: White sugar futures ended mixed with nearby positions reversing their earlier upward move to end Tuesday at the day's lows. Distant months were higher in thin volume.
The market rallied briefly earlier in the day after New York's May contract cleared 11.00 cents a lb but the advance was shortlived.

The foray to an intraday high of 11.01 cents was capped by producer pricing and was not enough to boost activity in London, where the equivalent May whites contract hit a high of $308.10 but then fell back into a range.
May closed 60 cents down at $306.10 a tonne while other traded months wre $1.10 up to 30 cents down.
Traders said arbitrage activity against the Paris market had provided much of the day's volume after commission house crossed trades earlier in the session.
The London/Paris differentials for May and August were the most active, whereas arbitrage activity against New York was minimal, they said.
"If you're not involved with that, you're not doing much of anything. There's nothing going on," said one.
London's May/Aug spread traded at around 20 cents and traders said light interest was also noted in Aug/Oct.
